usageNotes: Unmounts a directory-backed storage mount and removes its systemd mount unit from the specified node; requires `Sys.Modify` at the root level, and additionally `Datastore.Allocate` on `/storage/<name>` when using `cleanup-config`. Pass `cleanup-config: true` to also remove the storage from the cluster configuration (or mark it unavailable on this node); pass `cleanup-disks: true` to wipe the underlying disk so it can be repurposed. The operation returns a task UPID — poll the task status before treating the storage as fully removed.

examples.summary: Remove a directory storage named 'local-data' from node 'pve1', clean up its config entry, and wipe the disk for reuse

destructiveReason: Unmounts the directory and removes the mount unit; with cleanup-disks enabled, the underlying disk is wiped and all data on it is permanently destroyed.
tips: Always verify no VMs or containers are actively using the storage before calling this — running guests with disks on the target storage will cause the unmount to fail.
The return value is a UPID string; use get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status to poll completion before assuming the storage is fully gone.
cleanup-config only removes the storage from this node's config if it is configured exclusively for this node; otherwise it marks it unavailable here, leaving the entry for other nodes.
